mapper.select: SELECT ID AS memberId, PASSWORD AS password, NAME AS name, EMAIL AS email, ROLE AS role, JOIN_DATE AS joinDate, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, WITHDRAW_DATE AS withdrawDate FROM TB_MEMBER ORDER BY JOIN_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER ( ID, PASSWORD, NAME, EMAIL, ROLE, JOIN_DATE, MEMBER_STATUS, WITHDRAW_DATE ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, 'USER', SYSDATE, 'ACTIVE', NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS memberId, PASSWORD AS password, NAME AS name, EMAIL AS email, ROLE AS role, JOIN_DATE AS joinDate, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, WITHDRAW_DATE AS withdrawDate FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE ID = #{memberId} AND PASSWORD = #{password} AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT ID AS memberId, PASSWORD AS password, NAME AS name, EMAIL AS email, ROLE AS role, JOIN_DATE AS joinDate, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, WITHDRAW_DATE AS withdrawDate FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE ID = #{_parameter} AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
